Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:12:1.hebrew: בששמעו בו שמת כולי עלמא לא פליגי דמורידין - דאם יבאו הבעלים קודם שיאכל זה הפירות, יטול זה כשאר אריסין ויחזיר השאר; ואם יבאו עדים שמת, ירש הכל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:12:1.english: Where they heard that he died, everyone agrees that [the court] authorizes [a relative] to descend - For if the owner comes [back] before this [relative] consumes the produce, this [relative] takes [a share] like other sharecroppers and returns the rest; and if witnesses come [and testify] that he died, he inherits everything.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:13:1.english: He ruins them - [That is,] he will not fertilize the lands, and he will sow them continuously and weaken them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:13:2.hebrew: כיון דאמר מר - לקמן: "וכולם שמין להם כאריס". אם יבאו הבעלים, שמין לזה חלקו בכל שנה שעבד בה כמנהג אריסי העיר — אם מחצה, אם שליש, אם רביע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:13:2.english: Since the Master said - Later on [the Gemara cites]: "And for all of them we appraise for them as a sharecropper." If the owners return, we appraise for this [relative] his share for every year that he worked it, according to the custom of the sharecroppers of the city — whether a half, whether a third, [or] whether a quarter.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:15:1.hebrew: אלא מלמד שנשיהם מבקשות לינשא כו' - שילכו בשבי, ולא ידעו בניהם אם חיים אם מתים, ויהיו נשיהם אלמנות לעולם, שאין ב"ד מניחין אותן לינשא, ובניהם כיתומים, שלא ירשו נכסיהם. ושתי קללות הן: אחת של חרב ואחת של שבי. שמע מינה: אין מורידין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:15:1.english: Rather, [the verse] teaches that their wives seek to marry, etc. - That they will go into captivity, and their children will not know whether [their fathers] are alive or dead, and their wives will be widows forever, for the court does not allow them to marry, and their children [will be] like orphans, in that they will not inherit their [fathers'] property. And they are two curses: one of the sword and one of captivity. Learn from this: we do not authorize [a relative] to descend [to a captive's property].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:16:1.english: There was an incident in Nehardea - Regarding a captive whose heir descended to his property.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:16:2.english: And Rav Sheshet resolved it from this baraita - that we do not send [a relative] down [to the property].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:16:3.hebrew: א"ל רב עמרם דלמא לירד ולמכור תנן - [קתני] תנא דאין מניחין, אבל לעשות ולאכול וליטול כאריס שפיר דמי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:16:3.english: Rav Amram said to him: Perhaps we learned: to descend and to sell - [The Tanna] teaches that we do not allow [a relative to do so], but to work [the land], consume [its produce], and take [a share] like a sharecropper is fine.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:16:4.hebrew: דמעיילין פילא כו' - ומשני שנוייא דחיקא, כמבקש להכניס פיל, שהוא חיה גדולה, בנקב מחט:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:16:4.english: Who bring an elephant, etc. - And they give a forced answer, like one who seeks to insert an elephant, which is a large animal, into the eye of a needle.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:17:1.english: And uprooted - [the] produce of this year.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:17:2.hebrew: הרי זה זריז - מהיר לזכות בשלו בטרם יפסיד, ונשכר בזריזותו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:17:2.english: Behold, this [person] is diligent - [He is] quick to take possession of what is his before he loses [it], and he profits through his diligence.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:17:3.english: And these are captives’ property - Regarding which [the baraita] said that we do not remove them from his possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:18:1.english: That abandoned [properties are] like [those of] captives - And [the court] does not remove [them] from his possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:18:2.english: Abandoned property - For the properties are abandoned.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:19:1.hebrew: נכסי רטושין - שהנכסים רטושים, ולקמן מפרש להו. רטושין משמע שעזבום בעלים מדעתם והלכו להם, דכיון דהיה לו לצוות "הורידו יורשיי לנכסי" ולא צוה, ש"מ לא ניחא ליה. ונטושים — שנטשום בעליהם בעל כרחן, כגון שנשבו; והיינו תנאי, דרבן שמעון סבר מורידין, ורבנן סברי אין מורידין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:19:1.english: Forsaken property - [Meaning] that the property is forsaken, and later [the Gemara] explains them. Retushin implies that the owners left them willingly and went away, for since he could have instructed, "Have my heirs descend to my property," and he did not instruct [so], learn from this [that] it is not pleasing to him. Whereas netushin [implies] that their owners abandoned them against their will, such as where they were taken captive; and this is [the dispute of] the Tannaim, for Rabban Shimon holds [that] we have [a relative] descend [to the property], while the Rabbis hold [that] we do not have [one] descend.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:1:1.english: For what are they fit - [Because] it teaches, "one sells them."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:1:3.hebrew: לכתישא דגמלא - לכתישא שעל הגמל, שגבו כתוש ומסוקב מחמת משאוי, איישר"א בלע"ז:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:1:3.english: For a sore of a camel - [This refers] to a sore that is on a camel, whose back is bruised and ulcerated because of a load — *eschare* [a saddle sore] in Old French.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:2:1.english: For his casks - The vessel in which it was [contained] will be ruined if it remains inside it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:3:1.hebrew: במאי קמיפלגי - ר"מ ורבנן, מאחר שמודה ר"מ ביתר מכדי חסרונן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:3:1.english: With regard to what do they disagree - Rabbi Meir and the Rabbis, since Rabbi Meir agrees in [the case of] more than their [standard] rate of loss.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:3:2.english: For a significant loss - Such as [deterioration] greater than their [standard] measure of loss.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:3:3.hebrew: הפסד מועט - כגון בכדי חסרון דריקבון פירות, וקילקול הקנקן דיין והחמיץ:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:3:3.english: An insignificant loss - Such as [loss] within the [standard] measure of deficiency from rotting fruit, and the spoiling of the jug of wine [when] it soured.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:5:1.hebrew: ערב - בגט פשוט (ב"ב קע"ג:):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:5:1.english: Guarantor - In [the chapter entitled] Get Pashut (Bava Batra 173b).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:5:3.hebrew: ראייה - בדיני ממונות השני (סנהדרין לא.), שנחלקו בשני מחלוקות במביא שטר ראיה לסתור את הדין; בראשונה הלכה כמותו, ובאחרונה אין הלכה כמותו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:5:3.english: Evidence - In the second [chapter of] Dinei Mamonot (Sanhedrin 31a), where they disagreed in two disputes regarding one who brings a document of proof to overturn the verdict: in the first [dispute] the halakha is in accordance with his [opinion], and in the final [dispute] the halakha is not in accordance with his [opinion].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:6:1.hebrew: אמוראי נינהו - רבה אמר בכללא אמר ר' יוחנן, ור' אבא אמר לאו בכללא אמר רבי יוחנן, אלא יש מהן שהלכה כמותו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:6:1.english: They are Amoraim - Rabbah says [that] Rabbi Yochanan stated [it] as a general rule, and Rabbi Abba says [that] Rabbi Yochanan did not state [it] as a general rule; rather, there are [some] of them whom the halakhah follows.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:7:1.english: From Rabban Shimon it is learned that we install a relative - [One] who is fit to inherit.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:7:2.hebrew: בנכסי שבוי - לקרקעות שבוי, לעובדן ולשומרן עד שיבאו הבעלים. ולקמן פליגי בא אמוראי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:7:2.english: In the property of a captive - [He descends] to the lands of a captive, to work them and to guard them until the owners come. And later on, Amoraim disagree about it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:8:1.english: Rabban Shimon only said here - that one sells them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:8:2.hebrew: אלא משום דקא כליא קרנא - אם יניחם שם, אבל גבי קרקעות וכרמים, אע"פ שמתקלקלות קצת, לא כליא קרנא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:8:2.english: Only because the principal is being destroyed - if he leaves them there; however, regarding lands and vineyards, even though they deteriorate somewhat, the principal is not destroyed.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:8:3.english: Either like Rav Kahana - Who said above, "A person prefers his own kav [of produce]."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:8:4.english: Or [according to] Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak - who said [that we are concerned] lest he made them terumah and tithe.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:9:1.hebrew: דתרי טעמי נינהו - מתני' ונכסי שבוי, ואיכא דאית ליה מוכרין פירות האבודין ולית ליה מורידין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:9:1.english: That they are two reasons - [Namely,] our Mishnah and [the case of] the property of a captive, and there is one who holds [that] we sell produce that would be lost, yet does not hold [that] we authorize [a relative] to descend [to manage a captive's property].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 38b:9:2.english: A relative - [One] who is fit to inherit him, and there is no one closer than him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 38b:12:1.hebrew: בששמעו בו שמת כ"ע ל"פ דמורידין - אין לפרש בששמעו בב' עדים, דא"כ פשיטא דמורידין, אלא ששמעו היינו בקול ועד אחד; אע"ג דשמעו בו שמת דבפ' ב' דייני גזירות (כתובות דף קז.) גבי אין פוסקין מזונות לאשת איש, משמע סוגיא דהתם דהוי בעדות גמורה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 38b:12:1.english: Where they heard that he died, everyone agrees that we install [the relative] - One should not explain [this as referring to a case] where they heard [it] from two witnesses, for if so, it is obvious that we install [him]; rather, "that they heard" means through a rumor or a single witness — even though [regarding the phrase] "they heard that he died" in the chapter [entitled] Shnei Dayanei Gezeirot (Ketubot 107a), concerning [the ruling that] "they do not allot sustenance to a married woman," the sugya there implies that it refers to full testimony.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 38b:15:1.hebrew: אמר רבא לירד ולמכור תנן - וא"ת: ואמאי לא פריך ממתניתין דהאשה שהלכה (יבמות דף קטז: ושם ד"ה שאין), דקתני: "מצינו שאין אחים נכנסין לנחלה על פיה", ולשני נמי "לירד ולמכור תנן"? וי"ל: דמהכא אלימא ליה לאקשויי, משום דדומיא דנשותיהם קתני, דמשמע כלל כלל לא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 38b:15:1.english: Rava said: We learned to descend and to sell - And if you will ask: Why did [the Gemara] not raise an objection from the Mishnah of HaIshah Shehalkhah (Yevamot 116b, and there s.v. she'ein), which teaches: "We have found that brothers do not enter into the inheritance on her testimony," and [the Gemara] could likewise answer: "We learned to descend and to sell"? And one can say: From here [from this baraita], it was stronger for [the Gemara] to object, because it teaches [the children's restriction] in a manner similar to "their wives," which implies [that they may not descend] at all.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 38b:17:1.hebrew: היורד לנכסי שבוי אין מוציאין אותו מידו - הוא הדין דאפי' מורידין אותו לכתחילה, דהא נטושים מורידין לרשב"ג דאמר הנטושים כשבויין, אלא אגב דתנא בסיפא בנטושים מוציאין, תנא נמי בשבויין אין מוציאין. וא"ת: לימא רב הלכה כתנא קמא ושמואל הלכה כרשב"ג? וי"ל: דלא שמיע להו ברייתא, אי נמי איכא דמפכי להו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 38b:17:1.english: One who descends to the property of a captive, [the court] does not confiscate it from his possession - The same law applies that [the court] even authorizes him to descend [to the property] from the outset, for [even in the case of] abandoned [property] they authorize [a relative] to descend according to Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, who says that abandoned [property] is like captives' [property]; rather, since [the baraita] taught in the latter clause regarding abandoned [property] that "they confiscate [it]," it also taught regarding captives' [property] that "they do not confiscate [it]." And if you ask: Let Rav say [that] the halakhah is in accordance with the Tanna Kamma, and [let] Shmuel [say that] the halakhah is in accordance with Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel? One can answer that they had not heard the baraita; or alternatively, there are those who reverse them.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 38b:8:1.hebrew: עד כאן לא קאמר רשב"ג כו' אבל הכא אין מורידין - וא"ת: והא לקמן מייתי דאית ליה לרשב"ג מורידין? וי"ל: דמהא ליכא למשמע מינה. אבל קשה, דמאי מוכיח דחד טעמא הוא מדשמואל דסבר כרשב"ג וסבר מורידין? לוכח כן מרשב"ג גופיה! וצ"ל דלא שמיע ליה ברייתא דלקמן:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 38b:8:1.english: "Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel only states [his opinion here,] etc., but here they do not authorize [a relative to descend]" - And if you say: But later [the Gemara] brings [a baraita showing] that Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel holds [that] they authorize [a relative to descend]? And one can answer: [The Gemara means] that from this [Mishnah] one cannot infer it. However, it is difficult: why does [the Gemara] prove that it is one [and the same] reason from Shmuel, who holds like Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel and holds [that] they authorize [a relative to descend]? Let it prove this from Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel himself! And one must say that [the questioner] had not heard the baraita [cited] later.
